name: Quaternion
description: API for creating and manipulating quaternions.

parameters.name: imaginary
parameters.description: The imaginary part of the quaternion.

parameters.name: scalar
parameters.description: The scalar part of the quaternion.

functions.name: fromEuler
functions.description: Creates a quaternion from Euler angles.

functions.name: toEuler
functions.description: Converts a quaternion to Euler angles in pitch, yaw, roll order.

functions.name: fromAxisAngle
functions.description: Creates a quaternion from an axis and an angle.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle of rotation in radians about the axis.

functions.name: conjugate
functions.description: Returns the conjugate of a quaternion.

functions.name: inverse
functions.description: Returns the inverse of a quaternion.

functions.name: rotate
functions.description: Rotates a vector by a quaternion.

functions.name: mul
functions.description: Multiplies two quaternions. Quaternion multiplication is not commutative.

returns.name: quaternion
returns.description: The product of the two quaternions.

functions.name: normalise
functions.description: Returns a normalised copy of the quaternion.

returns.name: normalisedQuaternion
returns.description: Copy of the quaternion with unit length.

functions.name: getRotationBetween
description: Returns a quaternion which will rotate the first direction to the second along the shortest path.

constants.name: IDENTITY
constants.description: An identity quaternion is the inverse of itself (i.e. it performs no rotation).

classes.name: Quaternion
classes.description: Rotation represented by imaginary and scalar components which does not suffer from gimbal lock.

properties.description: The imaginary part of the quaternion.
The scalar part of the quaternion.
